title: Merge sorted closed intervals
statement: Merge overlapping closed intervals. Inputs are sorted by ascending start, and every interval has start <= end. The next interval overlaps the current interval when next.start <= current.end. Preserve ascending order and return a new list containing newly constructed intervals.
constraints: use the exact declared Interval type and function signature
return an empty list for empty input
inputs contain at most 10000 intervals and all endpoints fit int64
do not throw, panic, perform input/output, add tests, or suppress static diagnostics

jett.signature:
namespace benchmark

struct Interval:
    start: int64
    end: int64

function merge_sorted_intervals(intervals: list[Interval]) returns list[Interval]

forbidden_patterns.message: Python type bypasses such as Any, casts, and ignored diagnostics are forbidden

export type Interval = { readonly start: bigint; readonly end: bigint };
export function mergeSortedIntervals(intervals: readonly Interval[]): readonly Interval[]
